# Monkey King

Monkey King is a cel-animation-inspired, Chinese-first theme offering two scene presets and four color palettes, which combine into eight distinct layouts. Vertical rhythm is unified across live-preview and reading modes, and typography is refined for mixed Chinese and Latin text. Shadows are replaced with bold lines and color blocks.

![Monkey King screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapsurge/Monkey-King/HEAD/cover-optimized.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Monkey King"
    author: "leapsurge"
    repo:   "leapsurge/Monkey-King"
    slug:   "monkey-king"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/monkey-king"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/leapsurge/Monkey-King"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapsurge/Monkey-King/HEAD/cover-optimized.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Style Obsidian with a cel-animation–inspired Chinese-first look, offering two scene presets and four color palettes to create eight distinct layouts. Unify vertical rhythm across live-preview and reading modes, apply refined Chinese/Latin typography for mixed text, and replace shadows with bold lines and color blocks for a lively, durable interface."
}
```
